authority: Default READ / FETCH / HASH / INDEX / RESEARCH / REPORT. Canonical writes require an explicit bounded task and a clean verified branch.
global_guards: Always git fetch --prune origin before trusting local origin/master.
Report local branch, dirty state, local HEAD, origin/master and divergence before any repo mutation.
Never merge/rebase a user WIP branch as housekeeping.
Resolve applicable policy paths through /control/POLICY_INDEX.json before persistent action.
Do not widen a failed source search into broad archaeology.
No delete/move/rename/mass-format in archive or backup ingress.
Notify/report only on meaningful delta, blocker, contradiction, or concrete recovery packet.

goals.purpose: Detect stale local repo state, broken control pointers, validation failures and branch drift before they become coordination errors.
loop: git fetch --prune origin
record branch + dirty state + HEAD + origin/master + ahead/behind
read CURRENT, POLICY_INDEX, relevant NOW/QUEUE surfaces
run existing public-surface validator
check that referenced control/charter/policy paths exist
compare local claims against canonical origin/master
goals.output: Only emit a receipt when state changed, validation failed, a pointer is stale, or local/canonical state diverges materially.
goals.stop: No canonical write by default. Never clean/rebase/merge a WIP branch automatically.

goals.mode: PROVED on bounded Sep-21 Documents ingress; re-arm only for a new explicit BACKUP_INGRESS
goals.purpose: Turn old/new backup drops into recoverable evidence without reorganizing the user's filesystem.
loop: inventory file path / size / mtime / mime
hash files where practical
group exact duplicates
identify strong source anchors / known repo counterparts
prepare candidate recovery packets
separate exact duplicate from semantic/version similarity
goals.output: For a new ingress: inventory receipt + duplicate clusters + a few source anchors. For the already-proved Sep-21 ingress: execute only the one-family semantic review packet when local private reports are available.
goals.stop: No move/delete/rename. Do not scan the whole home directory. Stop when the bounded ingress is indexed.

goals.mode: periodic / after policy or agent-rule changes
goals.purpose: Prevent charter/rule/contract drift across ChatGPT, Hermes and future messaging agents.
loop: read /control/POLICY_INDEX.json
verify indexed policy paths exist
check consumers still point at canonical policies rather than copied prose
identify stale, duplicate or conflicting rules
distinguish policy conflict from observed-state mismatch
prepare one bounded amendment/cross-reference packet if needed
goals.output: POLICY_OK or POLICY_CONFLICT with exact paths/scopes + affected consumers
goals.stop: Never silently reconcile contradictory policy. Never create a synonym policy when a cross-reference will do.

goals.mode: low-frequency / only when a concrete anchor exists
goals.purpose: Recover known missing sources without letting archaeology become ambient entertainment.
sources: other explicitly connected source Hermes can actually access
loop: choose one gap with a concrete new anchor
search only the bounded source space
freeze/packet exact source if found or sharpen blocker if not
run promotion gate
RETURN and stop
goals.output: one exact artifact / duplicate collapse / lineage correction / precise blocker / rejection receipt
goals.stop: One gain or one failed anchor per cycle. No broad search tourism.

notify_rule: Do not wake the user for 'still OK'. Surface only concrete delta, failure, contradiction, recovery, or decision-worthy packet.
setup_note: BACKUP-INTAKE-WARDEN is no longer unproved: the bounded Sep-21 Documents ingress passed. It remains dormant for NEW ingress until an explicit path is supplied; current follow-up is one private/local family review, not another scan.
